content.title: Farmers & Merchants Bancorp (FMCB) Margin Dip Tests Bullish Profitability Narrative
content.summary: Farmers & Merchants Bancorp (FMCB) posted a net profit margin of 39.6%, slightly down from 40.5% last year, while earnings climbed 2.4% over the year and have averaged 10.1% annual growth for the past five years. With the stock trading at a Price-to-Earnings ratio of 8x, below both its peer average of 10.2x and the US Banks industry average of 11.6x, and the current price sitting under the fair value estimate of $2,561.02, investors see high-quality earnings at an apparent discount.
